hints.title: Mimic column addition
hints.body: Start from the rightmost bit of both strings and move left.

hints.title: Carry
hints.body: At each column, add the two bits and the carry. The new bit is the sum modulo two.

hints.title: Unequal lengths
hints.body: Treat a missing position as zero until both strings and the carry are exhausted.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
i = len(first) - 1, j = len(second) - 1, carry = 0
result = []
while i >= 0 or j >= 0 or carry:
    total = carry
    if i >= 0: total += first[i]; i -= 1
    if j >= 0: total += second[j]; j -= 1
    result.append(total % 2)
    carry = total // 2
return reverse(result)
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
